children.game_version: Simplified procession walk with playful struts and gentle kicks

seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and smaller range of motion recommended

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Linked arms between partners, occasional use of canes or props for flair
movement_profile.footwork: High-stepping kicks alternating with slides and struts, performed in time with syncopated rhythm
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Partnered couples dance in procession or circle formations, moving forward and around
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Beginners perform basic struts and kicks; advanced dancers add improvisation and turns; jumps are energetic but not acrobatic
movement_profile.partnering: Couples linked arm-in-arm, coordinated stepping and kicking
movement_profile.posture: Erect upper body tilted slightly backward, dignified and poised

signature_moves.description: A pronounced upward kick with the leg while maintaining erect posture
signature_moves.name: High Kick

signature_moves.description: A proud, exaggerated step with lifted knees and pointed toes
signature_moves.name: Strut

signature_moves.description: Smooth gliding step forward to meet the other foot
signature_moves.name: Slide

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Lively and syncopated with alternating slow and fast sections
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid losing posture or rhythm; do not perform jumps that risk injury; respect cultural origins and avoid caricature

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated 'oom-pah' with two alternate heavy beats per bar, incorporating polyrhythm and habanera rhythm
music_profile.sound_description: Bright, rhythmic march with syncopated beats and lively tempo, featuring banjo and piano with playful, accented rhythms that support strutting dance steps.

basic_steps: Couples link arms and stand erect with slight backward tilt of upper body
Step forward with right foot, lifting knee high in a strut
Slide left foot forward smoothly to meet right
Perform a high kick with right leg
Repeat with left leg stepping and kicking
Alternate struts and slides in time with music
teaching.formation: Partnered couples in procession or circle formation
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on posture and timing of struts and kicks; intermediate add slides and turns; advanced incorporate improvisation and expressive gestures
teaching.rhythm: Syncopated 2/4 time with two accented beats per measure
